verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs describe single-item CRUD via CLI/API (add, search, list, update, delete) and an export feature for retrieving memories, but no evidence describes batch/bulk add, bulk update, or bulk delete operations across many memories at once. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk create-update-delete endpoints, evidence of processing multiple items in a single call, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk throughput.
